description: This file defines a JSON-RPC interface schema for the Linear Playback Control API, including method definitions, data structures, and event descriptions.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Current channel control interface, accepting a channel address.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seek position control in seconds offset from live.

methods.name: trickPlay
methods.description: Adjust trick play speed and direction.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Retrieve current buffer and seek status information.

methods.name: tracing
methods.description: Enable or disable tracing for debugging or logging.
